messages:
maria: quick FYI on PR #4620 - added an "examples" panel for tool calling + structured-output but two small regressions: the JS snippet uses `params` and the schema link points to the unversioned path.

eli: saw that. which schema should it link to?

maria: use /docs/schemas/tool-envelope-v2.json (we bumped the minor for clarifications). PR used /docs/schemas/tool-envelope.json -> 404.

thao: for the JS snippet change `params` -> `inputs` and prefer `await model.invoke()` over `generate()` for tool-style calls. also remove any comment that mentions "function_call" to avoid old jargon.

eli: will push a tiny follow-up: swap params->inputs, generate->invoke, update schema link to v2, add a one-line migration note (searchable): "function_call -> tool_call; params -> inputs".

maria: also add a defensive parse example for JS: `const env = JSON.parse(body||'{}'); const q = env?.inputs?.query ?? null;` and a guardrail sentence: "Always validate required inputs before forwarding to tools."

ci-bot: noted - please also add a one-line docs CI test that validates the example JSON against the schema with ajv. We already have the infra.

eli: added: small test at tests/docs/tool-envelope.test.js (ajv validate), updated changelog entry. Pushed commit. PTAL.

thao: quick review: lgtm but swap the Node example to use `invoke('wiki_search', { inputs: { query } })` explicitly, not positional args. Keeps cross-SDK parity.

eli: updated Node example to explicit options object. Re-ran docs link-checker locally.

ci-bot: docs/link-checker: external schema /docs/schemas/tool-envelope-v2.json resolved (200). docs/tests: ajv validation passed. lint: one trailing space fixed by formatter.

merge-bot: build/docs 1 success. ready to merge.

docs-bot: changelog: "Docs: fix tool-envelope examples (params->inputs), update examples to invoke(); add defensive parsing + schema validation test" (id: docs-4620-fix).

maria: nice, ty. follow-up: can someone draft a short migration snippet showing before/after for large integrators? e.g. old `function_call` envelope -> new `tool_call` envelope.

thao: i'll open a small PR with before/after and a note about enum `tool` values to avoid ambiguous routing.

maria: perfect. merging now.

merge-bot: merged 304. closing thread.
